fields.h1: Build a Supply Request Form That Turns Requests Into Orders
fields.hero_description: Build a supply request form that checks each request against a budget, routes it for approval, and saves it to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: From Request to Order, Without the Chasing
fields.features_subheading: Emergent builds the supply request form and the rules that decide who orders each item, and when.
fields.feature_1:
Item lines with quantity and need-by date

Each request lists the items, how many of each, and the date they are needed. A cost center field charges every order to the right team's budget before anyone places it.
fields.feature_2:
A weekly cutoff that merges requests

Set a day and time for ordering. Requests in before the cutoff are merged by item into one list, and the buyer sees eight reams of paper once, not five separate asks.
fields.feature_3:
Budget checked before anything is ordered

Give each team or classroom an allowance. The form shows the balance as the requester fills it in, and a request that would go over it goes to a manager before it is ordered.
fields.feature_4:
Approval above the dollar line you choose

Pick the amount that needs a manager's yes. Requests below it go straight to the buyer, and requests above it email the approver a summary with a link to approve or decline.
fields.feature_5:
Need-today requests go to the supply lead

A need-today box changes where a request goes. It sends the supply lead a direct message in Slack naming the item and the room, while routine requests wait for the order.
fields.feature_6:
Request history in a database you own

Every request is a row in your own database, with no cap on how many come in. Paid plans export the full code to your GitHub repository for you to host and keep building on.

fields.usecase_heading: Who Asks for Supplies, and Who Says Yes
fields.tab_content_1:
Every request in by Thursday noon joins one order

Requests at Haverleigh Architects trickle in all week. Anything submitted by noon on Thursday goes on that week's order. This week 14 requests came in, and at noon the app emails office manager Eamon Pickersgill one list of 4 items, each with the number of people who asked. He places a single order.
fields.tab_content_2:
$24 of Zora's allowance is left after the art supplies

Zora Weatherbee teaches at Merriwick Elementary, and her classroom allowance is $300 for the year. She has spent $214. Her new request is $62.00 of construction paper and washable markers, and the form checks it against her balance as she fills it in. It fits with $24 to spare and goes straight to the front office.
fields.tab_content_3:
When room 3 runs out of gloves, Isolde hears in Slack

Exam room 3 at Fitzwarren Pediatrics is out of medium gloves before a full afternoon. Medical assistant Cosmo Abernathy-Choi asks for 6 boxes and ticks Need today. The request skips the weekly order, and the app sends supply lead Isolde Brennholt a direct message in Slack. She brings them up before the next patient.
fields.tab_content_4:
At $516, it needs Clementine's approval by email

Tavish Moffatt runs a 6-person crew at Henneberg Landscaping. Before spring cleanups he asks for safety vests, trimmer line, and work gloves, a request that totals $516.00. Anything over $500 waits for operations manager Clementine Szabo-Reyes, who approves it from an email. Smaller requests go to the buyer.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Supply Request Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to a supply request form that puts every request in front of the person who orders it, built with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Set allowances and an approval line
fields.howto_step_1_des: Pull the last three months of supply emails and hallway asks. Group the items into the categories you order from, such as paper goods or cleaning supplies. Each category becomes a choice on the form, with its own short list of items to pick.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Each line needs an item and a quantity. Put the need-by date and the cost center at the top, once per request. Leave a notes box for brand or size, since a box of gloves in the wrong size is a wasted order.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Choose the day and hour when requests close for the week. Anything in before it lands on one list, counted by item. Print the cutoff on the form itself, next to the submit button, where nobody can miss it.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Give teams or classrooms a yearly allowance if you track one, and decide the dollar amount that needs a manager. A request under the line and inside the allowance goes straight to the buyer. Anything else waits for a yes.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Add a need-today box and name one person who handles it. That person gets a direct message in Slack, and everyone else keeps waiting for the weekly list. Write down what counts as urgent before staff start ticking it.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Describe it all in one prompt
fields.howto_step_6_des: Write it the way you would brief a new office manager: the form, the cutoff, the allowance, and who approves what. Emergent builds the form, the routing, and the database behind them from that prompt. Change anything later by asking for it in plain English.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Submit one routine request, one over the approval line, and one marked need today. Check that each lands with the right person and that the weekly list counts every item once. Then share the form link with staff.

faq_plan.q: What is a supply request form?
faq_plan.ref: What is a supply request form?

prov.original: What is a supply request form?

faq_plan.a: A supply request form is how an employee asks for items that get used up, such as printer paper or exam gloves, from whoever orders or stocks them. It records who is asking, which items and how many, when they are needed, and which budget pays.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a supply request form?
faq_plan.a: Describe the form to Emergent's AI form builder in plain English: the items people request and the dollar line for approval. Emergent builds the form and a database that holds every request. Test it with a few requests of your own, then share the link with staff.

faq_plan.q: What should a supply request form include?
faq_plan.a: The essentials are who is asking, what they need, how many, and by when. Two more fields help the person ordering. A unit price lets the form total each request and check it against an approval line. A delivery spot, such as a room number or job site, gets the order to the right door.

faq_plan.q: Who should approve a supply request form before anything is ordered?
faq_plan.a: Set a dollar line and send requests above it to the person who owns the budget they are charged to, such as a department head or a principal. Requests below the line can go straight to the buyer. If the money pays a vendor or a person directly for something other than stock, use a check request form.

faq_plan.q: How is a supply request form different from a procurement request?
faq_plan.a: A supply request form asks for items, and the buyer fills it from the stockroom or adds it to the next order. A procurement request asks a purchasing team to buy goods or services from an outside vendor, with the vendor, the quoted price, and the budget code attached.

faq_plan.q: Is there a free supply request form template I can customize?
faq_plan.a: Yes, and you can skip editing a fixed template. Describe the form you need and Emergent builds it from that prompt, and the free tier covers building and publishing. Change a field or the approval amount later by asking for it.

faq_plan.q: Should repair requests go on the same form as supply requests?
faq_plan.a: Keep them apart. A broken printer or a leaking sink needs a technician, not a buyer. Put it on a maintenance request form. A supply request ends in an order. A repair ends when facilities closes the work order.

faq_plan.q: How can a supply request form check spending against a budget?
faq_plan.a: Give each team a yearly allowance, and the form compares every request with what is left before it goes to the buyer. A request that would cross the balance waits for the budget owner. Emergent keeps every request in a database you own with no cap on submissions, and a full year of spending sits in one table you can report from.

faq_plan.q: How do I add status updates to a supply request form?
faq_plan.a: Add a status field that moves with each request: submitted, approved, ordered, delivered. The app can email the requester when the order is placed and again when it arrives, and a page lists every open request with its current status.

faq_plan.q: Should laptops and tools go on a supply request form?
faq_plan.a: No. Laptops and ladders last for years and carry a serial number and an owner. Put them on an equipment request form. Keep the supply request form for things that get used up, like paper and gloves.

plan.angle: The top 10 is template galleries and fillable files (office supply request templates, a college supply room form, an army supply request template): each collects a requester, items and quantities on a page, and none shows what happens after the form is sent. This page covers the internal supply request, from staff to whoever orders or stocks supplies, and the parts that decide what happens next: a weekly cutoff that merges requests into one order, a classroom allowance checked before ordering, a need-today flag that messages the supply lead, and a dollar line above which a manager approves. Vendor-facing orders stay on the order form page, repairs on the maintenance request page, laptops and tools on the equipment request page.
